entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To check an order status, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Two.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not working out for me.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's David Chen. Order number VF-554-9812.

Thank you, David. One moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered 13 days ago. No problem at all, you're well within our 90-day return window, so we can definitely get that started for you.
Oh, 90 days? Perfect. That's a relief. Yes, please, let's process that return.
Absolutely. I'm just initiating the process now and... oh. Hold on a moment, David. I am so sorry, I've made an error.
An error? What kind of error?

I apologize. I was looking at our standard VeloFit policy. It seems that specific electronic items, including the VeloBand Pulse, have a different policy. It actually has a strict 10-day return window.
Wait, what? But **you just said** it was 90 days. I heard you perfectly clear.

I understand your frustration, and that was completely my mistake. I misquoted the policy. I sincerely apologize. As your order was delivered 13 days ago, it's unfortunately three days past the return window for this specific item.

This has to be a joke. This is a **recorded line**, right? You can literally go back and hear that you **promised me** I could return it. This feels like a complete **bait and switch**! You tell me yes, and then 'oops, sorry, no'.

Sir, I assure you it wasn't intentional, but I do understand why you feel that way. I take full responsibility for giving you incorrect information. While the system won't let me override the 10-day policy for a refund, I do want to make this right for you, especially since this was my error.
So I'm just stuck with it? This is unacceptable.

Not at all. Because I gave you the wrong information, I am going to issue you a full store credit for the value of the VeloBand Pulse, which is $149.99. You can keep the device. Furthermore, for the trouble and confusion I've caused, I am adding an additional $25 inconvenience credit to your VeloFit account.
Hold on. So you're saying I get to keep this band, and I'm getting the full purchase price back as store credit, plus another $25?
That is correct. A total of $174.99 in VeloFit store credit will be available in your account immediately.
Wow. Okay. That's... a lot better than I expected. I can definitely use that credit on some other gear. That's actually a great solution.
I'm very glad to hear that, David. I've just applied that credit to your account, you should see it if you log in. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Hey, thank you for fixing your mistake like that. I really appreciate you taking care of it.
It's my pleasure. We value you as a VeloFit customer. Thank you for your understanding, and have a great rest of your day.
